text: 你催促惊呆的学生们逃跑，但他们已经来不及了。你奔逃时，身后传来的惨叫令你战栗。你回头一瞥，只见雪地染血，风行者正撕扯他们的身体。
你唯一的希望，是怪物已经吃饱，不会继续追你。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 187
text: You urge your thunderstruck students to flee. But it is too late for them. As you run, you shiver at their cries. Throwing a glance over your shoulder, you see bloodied snow and the wind-walker ripping at their bodies.
Your only hope is that the creature will be sated and not pursue you.
